svg:
PostgreSQL Database ERD — Agricultural Marketplace Schema: public | Reference: auth.users (external)
auth.users (external Supabase auth table)
profiles 🔑 id (uuid) PK full_name (text) phone (text) avatar_path (text) rating_avg (numeric(2,1)) rating_count (int) created_at (timestamptz) updated_at (timestamptz) deleted_at (timestamptz) barangay / municipality / province farm_size_hectares (numeric) years_farming_experience (smallint) rice_varieties (text[]) rsbsa_number / verification_status
listings 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users title (text) description (text) price (numeric(12,2)) unit (text) CHECK kg/sack/cavan/lot category (text) CHECK quantity (numeric(12,2)) lat / lng (double) location_label / seller_name status (text) CHECK reserved_for (uuid) FK→auth.users sold_to (uuid) FK→auth.users reserved_for_name / sold_to_name created_at / sold_at / reserved_at
listing_images 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 listing_id (uuid) FK→listings storage_path (text) position (smallint) created_at (timestamptz)
forum_posts 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users author_name (text) title (text) body (text) heart_count / comment_count (int) category (text) CHECK created_at / updated_at / deleted_at
forum_comments 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 post_id (uuid) FK→forum_posts 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users author_name (text) body (text) heart_count (int) created_at / updated_at / deleted_at
forum_reactions 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users 🔗 post_id (uuid) FK→forum_posts 🔗 comment_id (uuid) FK→forum_comments created_at (timestamptz) CHECK: exactly one of post_id/comment_id
forum_images 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 post_id (uuid) FK→forum_posts storage_path (text) position (smallint) created_at (timestamptz)
conversations 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 listing_id (uuid) FK→listings 🔗 buyer_id (uuid) FK→auth.users 🔗 seller_id (uuid) FK→auth.users listing_title (text) buyer_name / seller_name (text) last_message_at (timestamptz) last_message_preview (text) buyer_last_read_at / seller_last_read_at created_at / updated_at CHECK: buyer_id <> seller_id
messages 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 conversation_id (uuid) FK→conversations 🔗 sender_id (uuid) FK→auth.users body (text) created_at (timestamptz)
transactions 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 listing_id (uuid) FK→listings listing_title (text) price (numeric(12,2)) unit (text) CHECK 🔗 seller_id (uuid) FK→auth.users seller_name (text) 🔗 buyer_id (uuid) FK→auth.users buyer_name (text) status (text) CHECK reserved_at / sold_at / created_at
reviews 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 transaction_id (uuid) FK→transactions listing_title (text) 🔗 reviewer_id (uuid) FK→auth.users reviewer_name (text) reviewer_role (text) CHECK 🔗 reviewee_id (uuid) FK→auth.users reviewee_name (text) rating (smallint) CHECK 1-5 comment (text) created_at (timestamptz) UNIQUE(transaction_id, reviewer_id)
profile_credentials 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users credential_type (text) CHECK issuing_organization (text) certificate_number (text) document_path (text) created_at / updated_at
profile_affiliations 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users organization_name (text) membership_id (text) proof_path (text) created_at / updated_at
profile_endorsements 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users municipality (text) issuing_office (text) date_issued (date) endorsement_type (text) CHECK document_path / created_at
profile_documents 🔑 id (uuid) PK 🔗 user_id (uuid) FK→auth.users label (text) document_path (text) created_at / updated_at
Legend 🔑 Primary Key (PK) 🔗 Foreign Key (FK) <line x1="52" y1="118" x2="100" y2="118" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray
